public_API.configure(role:String, initial:float=50): Call BEFORE add_child; accepts approach or intensity only. Returnsfalse for invalid role/inside-tree/disposed use. Does not emit level_changed. Approach min180x180/focus source; intensity min100x190/vertical source.
public_API.hydrate_level(value:float)->void: Direct guarded bounded/quantised assignment and redraw, zero value callbacks. Invalidates pending pointer gesture so stale release cannot restore or apply an old value.
public_API.set_level(value:float)->void: Original API/signature. Normalises0/50/100 for approach or rounded0..100 intensity, then calls super.set_level for change-only level_changed(float). No resolver/save.
public_API.level:float: Inherited current bounded visual/free-draft value. Do not directly assign except controlled pre-tree configuration/hydration.
public_API.level_changed(float): Inherited original signal. Host may update free draft/selected wording/preview in place ONLY, including a cancellation rollback. It must NOT rebuild/free the widget, commit, save, spend or advance time from this callback.
public_API.set_read_only(bool)->void: Use this method for runtime state changes; updates inherited read_only plus native focus/mouse/cursor settings and cancels any owned gesture with free rollback. Direct read_only assignment is supported pre-tree only.
public_API.cancel_gesture()->void: Clears owned capture and synchronously restores pregesture visual value/free draft ifchanged. Unowned calls emit nothing.
public_API.get_visual_rect()->Rect2: Uniform-fit local destination of the raw source crop; wholeControl retains native target/focus ownership.
public_API.finite_values: configure rejects nonfinite initial values (returnsfalse); hydrate_level/set_level ignore nonfinite values BEFORE clearing ownership or editing the free draft.

input_contract.housing: Fixed, NON-SCROLLING decision housing; entire interactiveControl is MOUSE_FILTER_STOP/FOCUS_ALL. Do not embed this same-axis vertical drag in a scrolling form without a new explicit arbitration contract.
input_contract.physical_target: Configured min180x180 or100x190; root proves actual transformed>=48px targets at all sizes.
input_contract.pointer: Deliberate primary press grabs focus and owns a relative vertical drag. No click-to-jump. One touch index owns the gesture; second touch press/release/drag ignored. Raw touch owns mouse-1 emulation; negative/internal-2 and canceled releases cancel; real mouse motion without left mask cancels. Normal owned release updates only free value and clears ownership before callback.
input_contract.screen_motion: Drag uses get_screen_transform for physical distance; fader travel equals its410source-pixel cap travel at uniform rendered scale, with48px minimum screen travel.
input_contract.keyboard: Focused approach arrows one detent; intensity arrows one integer. Home0/End100. Echo/release consumed without value change. Escape cancels owned gesture. Tab is left to native focus routing.
input_contract.wheel: Never adjusts level; mouse_force_pass_scroll_events=true preserves ordinary parent wheel routing. No simultaneous value+scroll change.
input_contract.cancel: Focus exit/window focus exit/hide/resize/scroll-begin/read-only transition/explicit cancel restore pregesteure draft only while ownership existed. Clear ownership BEFORE final synchronous rollback signal.
input_contract.teardown: _exit_tree marks disposed, disconnects window focus callback, then performs any final OWNED synchronous rollback while node stillvalid. No await, tween, timer, call_deferred or late signal exists. Postdisposal input/setters ignored.
input_contract.read_only: PASS/NONE/arrow cursor, no input changes. Runtime flag updates must use set_read_only rather than assigning inherited read_only directly.
input_contract.keyboard_takeover: Arrow/Home/End during an owned drag invalidates it and steps from its pregesture value; stale pointer motion/releases are ignored. Escape contract is press-triggered.
